label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.3 a.5…: GOD_4 is not properly in any genus
locator: I q.3 a.5 co., second proof: Unde relinquitur quod Deus non sit in genere
interpretation: Read as the conclusion of the second proof only: God is not properly in a genus (as a species). The article's fuller conclusion (neither as species nor by reduction as a principle) is not claimed here.
